title: incident-bot: integrate SLO-toolkit heuristics and quicklinks into oncall autodiagnostics
author: Marta Chen
description: Motivation: improve oncall autodiagnostics by surface-recommending SLO-toolkit heuristics and contextual quicklinks to runbooks and remediation steps. This PR wires SLO-toolkit scoring into incident-bot's diagnostics pipeline, adds quicklink generation for top-ranked runbooks, and exposes a lightweight heuristics config to tune prioritization per-service. Changes were driven by recent oncall feedback where responders wanted ranked, actionable runbook links and SLO-specific hints in the initial oncall message. Implementation summary: 1) new heuristics adapter to translate SLO-toolkit outputs into incident-bot signal weights; 2) quicklink generation engine that selects and ranks runbooks based on SLO context and recent playbook run frequency; 3) oncall message template updates to render compact quicklinks and top heuristics hints; 4) migration of existing runbook metadata into the new runbook registry index. Checklist: [x] add heuristics adapter and unit tests; [x] quicklink selection + ranking logic; [x] template updates and snapshot tests; [x] e2e smoke against oncall playground; [x] docs and runbook metadata migration script. Backwards compatibility: the new heuristics adapter is opt-in via feature flag incident_bot.autodiag.slo_integration=true and defaults to off for private installs until customers opt in. Testing notes: unit and integration test suites updated and included; manual validation run with oncall playground for a sampled SLO alert stream. Related: ENG-1345, ENG-1352, SUP-9082. Attachments: sample rendered oncall message and ranking trace included in commit history.
